newsitem.title: USA: McDonnell Douglas nears sale to Lufthansa - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: McDonnell Douglas nears sale to Lufthansa - WSJ.

text.p: McDonnell Douglas Corp is close to landing an agreement from Deutsche Lufthansa AG to buy up to 12 of the plane maker's MD-11 cargo jets in a deal that could be valued at $1.3 billion, The Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday.
The German carrier is said to be placing firm orders for five planes valued at about $545 million, and securing future options to buy seven more of the three-engine jumbo jets.

McDonnell Douglas has not received a sizable MD-11 order from a big-name carrier in more than a year. For much of the last three years, McDonnell's chief executive, Harry Stonecipher, has been working to persuade the world's airlines that McDonnell has overcome its problems in the commercial jetliner business.

A McDonnell spokesman declined to comment on the anticipated MD-11 order. But people familiar with the talks said an agreement could be announced before Britain's Farnborough International Air Show concludes this week.
